$comment: Generated by 'npm run factory -- compile 056'. Do not edit by hand, except to set an AC's passes/evidence from a green CI run.
title: A posted room or broadcast card shows, live, the text its leader is on

tasks.title: The relay reports each room's leader ref and headcount to the server, at most once per 5 seconds
The server keeps the reports and answers the public live status of embedded sessions
Live cards in posts poll for what is on screen and show the leader's text

acs.text: WHILE people are connected to a room or broadcast THE SYSTEM (the relay) SHALL report the leader's current ref, Hebrew ref, title and the number connected to the social server, signed with the relay's internal secret, when any of these changes and at least once a minute, and once when the last person leaves, but never more than one report per room per 5 seconds (a change inside the 5 seconds is sent at their end)
scenarios: AC-001 the relay reports changes, at most once per 5 seconds per room

acs.text: WHEN the social server receives a report THE SYSTEM SHALL accept it only with a valid signature and a timestamp within 5 minutes (401 otherwise) and keep the latest one per room; a report for a room or broadcast that does not exist SHALL be ignored
scenarios: AC-002 the server checks and keeps reports

acs.text: WHEN anyone, signed in or not, asks `GET /api/v1/live?ids=…` with 1 to 50 ids THE SYSTEM SHALL answer in one response `[{id, kind, live, ref, heRef, here, updatedAt}]` for each id that a post embeds, leaving out every other id; `live` SHALL be true only for a report under 3 minutes old with people connected (and, for a broadcast, while it is live); more than 50 ids SHALL be refused with 400; the answer SHALL carry an `ETag`, and a request whose `If-None-Match` equals it SHALL get 304

WHILE a post's live card is on screen and the tab is visible THE SYSTEM SHALL ask for the status of the cards on screen in one request every 15 seconds and show a Live badge, the ref (in Hebrew in the Hebrew interface) and that text, or, when not live, "Not live" with the last known ref; cards off screen and a hidden tab SHALL send no requests
scenarios: AC-004 polling only what is seen, only while visible

acs.text: WHEN the leader of a live room moves to another text THE SYSTEM SHALL show the new ref on the room's card in the feed within 20 seconds
scenarios: AC-005 a room card follows the leader within 20 seconds
